ViewObject.Name: InvoicesVO
ViewObject.SQLQuery:
SELECT A.IDENTIFIER INV_NO, A.DATES INV_DATE, A.CUST_CODE, -- V1.NAME CUSTOMER_NAME, A.INV_HEAD_TYPE, A.PAYMNT_DUE_DT AS DUE_DATE, /* DECODE(A.INV_HEAD_TYPE,'A',-1*COALESCE(B.QUANTITY,0)*COALESCE(B.PRICE,0), COALESCE(B.QUANTITY,0)*COALESCE(B.PRICE,0)) TAXABLE_AMOUNT,*/ CASE WHEN A.INV_HEAD_TYPE = 'A' THEN -1 * NVL(B.QUANTITY,0) * NVL(B.PRICE,0) ELSE NVL(B.QUANTITY,0) * NVL(B.PRICE,0) END AS TAXABLE_AMOUNT, --DECODE(A.INV_HEAD_TYPE,'A',-1,1) * (NVL(B.AMOUNT,0)+NVL(IGST_AMT,0)+NVL(SGST_AMT,0)+NVL(CGST_AMT,0)) "TOTAL_AMT", CASE WHEN A.INV_HEAD_TYPE = 'A' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * (NVL(B.AMOUNT,0) + NVL(B.IGST_AMT,0) + NVL(B.SGST_AMT,0) + NVL(B.CGST_AMT,0)) AS TOTAL_AMT, --DECODE(A.INV_HEAD_TYPE,'A',-1*COALESCE(A.TCS_AMT,0),COALESCE(A.TCS_AMT,0)) TCS_AMT, --DECODE(A.INV_HEAD_TYPE,'A',-1*COALESCE(A.OTHER_AMOUNT,0),COALESCE(A.OTHER_AMOUNT,0)) OTHER_AMOUNT, --SL.NAME NAME, --DECODE(A.INV_HEAD_TYPE,'A',-1*COALESCE(B.QUANTITY,0),COALESCE(B.QUANTITY,0)) QTY, A.UNIT_CODE, -- UPPER(A.DISTINATION) DESTINATION, -- B.PROD_CODE, -- IM.UOM, -- VW.ITEM_DESC PROD_NAME, -- VW.ITEM_GROUP PRODUCT_GROUP, --NVL(PCK.CONVER_FACT,0) AS "CLD SIZE", /* B.PACK_QTY "Sale Qty in (CLD)", B.BATCH_NO, B.CUST_MRP_PRICE AS MRP, B.MFG_DT AS MFG_DT, B.EXP_DT AS EXP_DT, */ -- COALESCE(B.PRICE,0) PRICE, --DECODE(A.INV_HEAD_TYPE,'A',-1*COALESCE(B.AMOUNT,0),COALESCE(B.AMOUNT,0)) AMOUNT, CASE WHEN A.INV_HEAD_TYPE = 'A' THEN -1 * NVL(B.AMOUNT,0) ELSE NVL(B.AMOUNT,0) END AS AMOUNT, /* DECODE(A.INV_HEAD_TYPE,'A',-1*COALESCE(B.SGST_AMT,0),COALESCE(B.SGST_AMT,0)) SGST, DECODE(A.INV_HEAD_TYPE,'A',-1*COALESCE(B.CGST_AMT,0),COALESCE(B.CGST_AMT,0)) CGST, DECODE(A.INV_HEAD_TYPE,'A',-1*COALESCE(B.IGST_AMT,0),COALESCE(B.IGST_AMT,0)) IGST,*/ -- B.GST_CODE, --- NULL TAX_NAME, D.DA_NO SALE_NOTE_NO, -- D.DA_DATE SALE_NOTE_DT, -- A.CONSIGNEE_NAME CONSIG_NAME, -- A.GR_NUMBER GR_NO, --A.GR_DATE GR_DT, --INITCAP(V2.NAME) TRANSPOTER, --D.LC_NO, --D.LC_DATE LC_DT, -- NULL LC_BANK, --I.INV_TYPE_DESC SALE_NOTE_TYPE, --A.VEHICLE_NO, (A.DATES + PAYMENT_PERIOD) PAY_DUE_DT, B.CUST_PO_NO, --P.CUST_PO_DATE PO_DT, --D.PLANTHO, -- A.EWAY_NO, -- A.DATES EWAY_DATE, -- V1.GST_REG_NO GSTN_NO, /*COALESCE(B.IGST_RATE,0) IGST_RATE, COALESCE(B.SGST_RATE,0) SGST_RATE, COALESCE(B.CGST_RATE,0) CGST_RATE,*/ --B.HSN_NO, -- INITCAP(S.NAME) PLACE_OF_SUPPLY, --SUBSTR(SL.GST_REG_NO,1,2) PLACE_OF_SUPPLY_STCD, --0 REBIT_RATE, --0 REBIT_AMT, --A.VOU_NO, -- A.VOU_DATE VOU_DT, -- DECODE(A.INV_HEAD_TYPE,'A',-1*COALESCE(A.NET_AMOUNT_FC,0),COALESCE(A.NET_AMOUNT_FC,0)) AMOUNT_FC, --NULL PLACE_OF_RECEIPT, --COALESCE(A.CURR_RATE1,0) EXC_RATE, -- NULL SHIPING_NO, -- COALESCE(D.COMM_DISC,0) TRAD_DIS, /*DECODE(A.INV_HEAD_TYPE,'A',-1* ROUND( ROUND( COALESCE(AMOUNT,0) + COALESCE(B.SGST_AMT,0) + COALESCE(B.CGST_AMT,0) + COALESCE(B.IGST_AMT,0) + COALESCE(A.TCS_AMT,0) - (COALESCE(DISCOUNT_AMOUNT,0)+COALESCE(TOOL_DISCOUNT,0)), 2) * COALESCE(D.COMM_DISC,0), 2), ROUND( ROUND( COALESCE(AMOUNT,0) + COALESCE(B.SGST_AMT,0) + COALESCE(B.CGST_AMT,0) + COALESCE(B.IGSTAND A.CUST_CODE = :P_CUST_CODE
AND ( -- Case 1: Invoice Number + Customer Code ( :P_INV_NO IS NOT NULL AND A.IDENTIFIER = :P_INV_NO AND :P_FROM_DATE IS NULL AND :P_TO_DATE IS NULL )
OR
-- Case 2: Date Range + Customer Code ( :P_INV_NO IS NULL AND :P_FROM_DATE IS NOT NULL AND :P_TO_DATE IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(A.DATES) BETWEEN TO_DATE(:P_FROM_DATE, 'DD-MM-YY') AND TO_DATE(:P_TO_DATE, 'DD-MM-YY') )
OR
-- Case 3: Invoice Number + Date Range + Customer Code ( :P_INV_NO IS NOT NULL AND A.IDENTIFIER = :P_INV_NO AND :P_FROM_DATE IS NOT NULL AND :P_TO_DATE IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(A.DATES) BETWEEN TO_DATE(:P_FROM_DATE, 'DD-MM-YY') AND TO_DATE(:P_TO_DATE, 'DD-MM-YY') ) )_AMT,0) + COALESCE(A.TCS_AMT,0) - (COALESCE(DISCOUNT_AMOUNT,0)+COALESCE(TOOL_DISCOUNT,0)), 2) * COALESCE(D.COMM_DISC,0), 2) ) TRAD_AMT,*/ --COALESCE(D.CASH_DISC,0) CASH_DIS_PER, -- SUBSTR(B.HSN_NO,1,4) HSN_NO4, -- A.DRIVER_NAME DRIVER_NAME, VRA.STATE_GST_CODE||'-'||VRA.STATE STATE, -- SCV.MEANING CHANGE_TYPE,
-- VRA.ADDRESS1||' '||VRA.ADDRESS2||' '||VRA.ADDRESS3||' '|| -- VRA.CITY||' '||VRA.STATE||'-'||VRA.PIN_CODE ADDRESS, B.DISCOUNT AS DISCOUNT, /* DECODE(A.INV_HEAD_TYPE,'A', -1*(COALESCE(B.QUANTITY,0)*COALESCE(B.PRICE,0)) -(COALESCE(B.DISCOUNT,0)+COALESCE(B.LINE_DISCOUNT,0)), (COALESCE(B.QUANTITY,0)*COALESCE(B.PRICE,0)) -(COALESCE(B.DISCOUNT,0)+COALESCE(B.LINE_DISCOUNT,0)) ) TAXABLE_VAL_AFTR_DIS,*/ /* B.GROSS_WT GROSS_WEIGHT, B.NET_WEIGHT FINISH_WEIGHT, A.VOU_DATE VOUCHER_DATE, A.PHONE_NO DRIVER_NO, */ -- ROUND(IG.GROSS_WT,2) INV_GROSS_WT, --DECODE(A.CANCELLED,'N','Active','Y','Cancelled') STATUS, CASE WHEN A.CANCELLED = 'N' THEN 'Active' WHEN A.CANCELLED = 'Y' THEN 'Cancelled' END AS STATUS, A.REMARKS REMARKS, 'acb2067a85dc1f114019aabbbbc72c9b538dfa4afb2849fcdd1f277107c09951' IRN_NO, A.NET_AMOUNT INV_AMOUNT, -- A.CONSIGNEE_CODE CONSIGNEE_CODE, -- U.GST_REG_NO, -- V1.CUST_GROUP CUSTOMER_GROUP, -- INVT.INV_TYPE_DESC BILL_TYPE, -- INITCAP(CG.CODE_DESC) CUSTOMER_GROUP_DESCRIPTION, /* V1.SEARCH_TERMS2, V1.SEARCH_TERMS, V1.SEARCH_TERM3, V1.SEARCH_TERM2, V1.SEARCH_TERM1,*/ B.ACK_NO as SALE_ORDER_NUMBER -- COALESCE(B.LINE_DISCOUNT,0) LINE_DISCOUNT FROM INVOICE_HEADER_SYS A LEFT JOIN INVOICE_DETAIL_SYS B ON A.INV_ID = B.INV_ID AND B.APPROVE = 'Y' LEFT JOIN INVOICE_TYPE_MASTER_SYS I ON A.UNIT_CODE = I.UNIT_CODE AND A.INV_HEAD_TYPE = I.INV_TYPE AND A.STOCK_TYPE = I.STOCK_TYPE AND I.SALE_REGISTER = 'Y' LEFT JOIN UNIT_SYS U ON A.UNIT_CODE = U.CODE LEFT JOIN VENDOR_MASTER_SYS V1 ON A.CUST_CODE = V1.VENDOR_CODE LEFT JOIN CUST_GROUP_SYS CG ON CG.CODE = V1.CUST_GROUP LEFT JOIN VENDOR_REGD_ADDRESS_SYS VRA ON V1.VENDOR_ID = VRA.VENDOR_ID LEFT JOIN MST_SEC_CONTROL_VALUES_SYS SCV ON V1.CUST_TYPE = SCV.CONTROL_CODE AND SCV.CONTROL_TYPE = 'CUS_CUSTOMER_TYPE' AND SCV.SBU_CODE = U.SBU_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT INV_HEAD_IDENTIFIER, SUM(GROSS_WT) GROSS_WT FROM INVOICE_DETAIL_SYS GROUP BY INV_HEAD_IDENTIFIER ) IG ON IG.INV_HEAD_IDENTIFIER = A.IDENTIFIER LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_CD, MAX(CONVER_FACT) CONVER_FACT FROM ITEM_PACKING_UOM_SYS GROUP BY ITEM_CD ) PCK ON PCK.ITEM_CD = B.PROD_CODE LEFT JOIN VENDOR_MASTER_SYS V2 ON A.TRANSPORTER_CODE = V2.VENDOR_CODE LEFT JOIN DESPATCH_ADVICE_HEADER_SYS D ON B.DISP_ADVICE_NO = D.DA_NO LEFT JOIN PURCHASE_ORDER_HEADER_SYS P ON B.ACK_NO = P.ACK_NUMBER LEFT JOIN SUB_LED_SYS SL ON A.UNIT_CODE = SL.UNIT AND A.CUST_CODE = SL.CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT STATE_GST_CODE, NAME, COUNT(*) FROM STATE_SYS WHERE STATE_GST_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY STATE_GST_CODE, NAME ) S ON S.STATE_GST_CODE = SUBSTR(SL.GST_REG_NO,1,2) LEFT JOIN INVOICE_TYPE_MASTER_SYS INVT ON INVT.INV_TYPE = A.INV_HEAD_TYPE AND INVT.UNIT_CODE = A.UNIT_CODE AND INVT.STOCK_TYPE = A.STOCK_TYPE LEFT JOIN VW_ALL_ITEM_DEF_LOC_MAS_SYS VW ON A.UNIT_CODE = VW.UNIT_CD AND B.PROD_CODE = VW.ITEM_CD LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_CD, ITEM_UOM AS UOM FROM VW_ALL_ITEM_MAS_SYS ) IM ON IM.ITEM_CD = B.PROD_CODE WHERE U.COMPANY_TYPE = 'FMCG' AND A.IDENTIFIER NOT LIKE '%DI%' AND A.INV_HEAD_TYPE <> 'X' AND A.CUST_CODE = :P_CUST_CODE
AND ( -- Case 1: Invoice Number + Customer Code ( :P_INV_NO IS NOT NULL AND A.IDENTIFIER = :P_INV_NO AND :P_FROM_DATE IS NULL AND :P_TO_DATE IS NULL )
OR
-- Case 2: Date Range + Customer Code ( :P_INV_NO IS NULL AND :P_FROM_DATE IS NOT NULL AND :P_TO_DATE IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(A.DATES) BETWEEN TO_DATE(:P_FROM_DATE, 'DD-MM-YY') AND TO_DATE(:P_TO_DATE, 'DD-MM-YY') )
OR
-- Case 3: Invoice Number + Date Range + Customer Code ( :P_INV_NO IS NOT NULL AND A.IDENTIFIER = :P_INV_NO AND :P_FROM_DATE IS NOT NULL AND :P_TO_DATE IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(A.DATES) BETWEEN TO_DATE(:P_FROM_DATE, 'DD-MM-YY') AND TO_DATE(:P_TO_DATE, 'DD-MM-YY') ) )
